_notes: Shared arena map for the sim (training env + Isaac Sim twin) and the real Tellos.
ALL POSITIONS ARE PLACEHOLDERS - measure the real room and update them.
Frame: origin on the floor directly below the center of tag 10 (the goal) on the goal wall.
+x points from the goal wall into the room, +z is up, +y completes a right-handed frame
(+y is to your right when you face the goal wall). Units: meters.
Tag 'size_m' is the edge of the black square (what the detector measures).
Tag 'normal' is the direction the printed face points; 'up' points from the tag center
toward the printed 'APRILTAG 36h11 / ID n' header. right = cross(up, normal).
Tag sizes from the team's tags.yaml: tags 1-9 (and 11) are 5.2 in = 132.08 mm black squares, tag 10 is 571.5 mm.

goal._zone_note: Attacker scores by touching the goal tag: zone = tag face + 0.1 m on each side, out to 0.3 m from the wall.
